answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 39432 Country: Bangladesh Title: The followers of Abul Ala Maududi say that all the Prophets are not masum Question: The followers of Abul Ala Maududi say that all the Prophets are not masum. But I believe that they are masum. Please answer me how the Prophets are masum? Answer ID: 39432 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 407/413/N=1433) It is mentioned in the books of beliefs that the Prophets (عليهم الصلاة والسلام) are innocent. Hence the view of Maududi Sahib that Prophets are not innocent is against the beliefs of Ahl Sunnah al-Jamah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
